messages:
SRE Alert Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected (1769851234) — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Impacting Hosted API and some Dedicated customers. Auto-created war room: https://warroom.redwood.internal/incident/1769851234

SRE Alert Bot: Pager sent to on-call rotation (Priya S.). Please acknowledge in thread.

Priya S.: Ack'd. Paging now. I'm pulling logs + metrics. @Alex R. can you stand up the runtime traces and check kernel selection/quant paths? I'll confirm severity and impact window.

Alex R.: On it. Standing up flame graphs, tailing inference logs, and checking recent kernel selection changes. War room link bookmarked.

Oncall Coordinator Bot: Pager acknowledgment recorded: Priya S. at 1769851240.

Priya S.: Initial checks: error rate ~18% over last 1m, p95 latency degraded. Hits both hosted and a few Dedicated endpoints that use the new kernel. Looking at rollout metadata now. Will update in ~5.

Maria G.: I'll prepare a status page draft. Proposed message:

```
We are investigating reports of increased error rates for inference requests to /v1/generate in us-west-2. Some Hosted API customers and a subset of Dedicated deployments may experience elevated error rates. Our on-call SREs are actively investigating. We will provide updates as we have more information.
```

Do you want me to include guidance for retries/backoff?

Alex R.: Add guidance: recommend exponential backoff retries and provide model-variant fallback 'gpt-small-quant' where acceptable. Note: no customer data loss expected.

Priya S.: Owner assignments: Technical owner: Alex R. Incident lead: Priya S. Communication owner: Maria G. Customer outreach owner: Dan K. Can all owners ACK?

Dan K.: Ack. I'll draft customer-facing communication for Dedicated customers and loop in AEs for sign-off. Recommend targeting customers seeing >5% error spikes.

Alex R.: Ack as tech owner. I'm initiating a canary rollback to the previous kernel selection on 10% of traffic to test mitigation.

SRE Alert Bot: Canary rollback job started for 10% traffic at 1769851265. Monitoring metrics and error rate.

Priya S.: Confirming paging/escalation: if not resolved within 15m escalate to SRE pager secondary @Sam T. Documenting escalation path in war room.

Sam T.: Ack and standing by to escalate.

Maria G.: Draft of internal status page staging ready: https://status-staging.redwood.com/incidents/1769851234 — I'll publish to public status once we have verified impact scope and an ETA.

Priya S.: Internal comms template for execs (copy):

```
Short summary: Elevated error rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 affecting Hosted API and some Dedicated customers.
Impact: intermittent 5xx responses and increased p95 latency.
Mitigation in progress: canary rollback initiated to previous kernel selection.
Owner: Alex R.
Incident lead: Priya S.
ETA: TBD (monitoring canary results).
Action items: monitor canary, collect logs/traces, prepare customer list for targeted notifications, draft status page update.
```

Alex R.: Canary metrics look promising so far — error rate in canary reduced to ~2% within 3m. If trend holds, we'll expand rollback.

Dan K.: Preparing Dedicated customer notification template now. Will post draft in war room and ask AEs to approve before send.

Priya S.: Noted. I'll update this thread and the war room with the follow-up timeline and assign any post-incident actions. Keeping incident open. Next update in 5 minutes. :white_check_mark:
